question: Should I buy a house in Toronto or keep renting?

content.text:
I can't tell you whether to buy or keep renting. That depends on your finances, how long you plan to stay, your risk tolerance and where mortgage rates go, and I can't give personal advice or forecasts.

I can pull Statistics Canada data to help you compare, such as Toronto rent levels, new housing price indexes, or the rent and owned-accommodation components of the CPI. Tell me which of these you want and I'll fetch them.
